channel.title: The Coin Wire
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

item.title: Coinbase lists Ripple’s RLUSD across retail and Prime platforms
item.description: Coinbase has added Ripple’s RLUSD across retail and institutional platforms, widening its dollar-token lineup while global exchange and collateral access await a later rollout.

item.title: JPMorgan adds Ethereum as second public chain for JPM Coin
item.description: JPMorgan has made its dollar deposit token available on Ethereum after Base, adding a public-chain route for institutional payments while keeping access restricted.

item.title: South Korea weighs fourth crypto tax delay to 2029
item.description: South Korea is weighing a fourth delay of its 22% crypto income tax to 2029, citing gaps in cross-border data as lawmakers consider changing the start date.

item.title: Ireland fines Coinbase unit €3.25 million over safeguarding failures
item.description: Ireland’s central bank fined Coinbase Ireland €3.25 million over years of safeguarding and oversight failures, with the penalty awaiting High Court confirmation.

item.title: JPMorgan Adds Solana Access for Two Tokenized Money Funds
item.description: JPMorgan has made MONY and JLTXX available on Solana through Morgan Money, adding a second network while keeping access limited to qualified U.S. investors.

item.title: Omnichain governance: one vote, several chains
item.description: Omnichain governance lets one community vote and execute changes across several chains, but its reach depends on how votes, messages and local control are secured.

item.title: Uniswap v4 adds outside liquidity on three chains
item.description: Uniswap’s v4 hooks add seven outside liquidity sources across three chains, widening route choice while charging protocol fees on external trades.

item.title: HSBC brings HKD RedCoin stablecoin to PayMe users
item.description: HSBC has launched its HKD stablecoin on PayMe, starting with transfers and merchant payments as its planned bank app and tokenised investment uses follow later.

item.title: A Leader’s Position Change Can Reshape Copy Risk
item.description: A leader’s position change can alter a follower’s size, direction and risk unevenly; the key is how the copy system handles fills, leverage and exits.

item.title: Why a Crypto Bridge Quote Can Change Before Funds Arrive
item.description: A bridge quote can shrink because of fees, swaps, or display rules; learn which amount is committed, deducted, and actually credited before you sign.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with a consensus system targeting 150ms finality while leaving wallets, apps and fees unchanged.

item.title: A Transfer Tax Changes What a Token Swap Can Deliver
item.description: A transfer-tax token can swap only when the route accounts for its actual received amount; slippage and token rules determine the final cost and whether it executes.

item.title: Citi takes tokenized deposits to Japan and UAE
item.description: Citi has added Japan and the UAE to its blockchain-based deposit service, extending 24/7 transfers across seven markets while testing whether private bank rails can connect.

item.title: A Failed Crypto Swap Can Still Cost You Gas
item.description: A failed crypto swap usually leaves the trade undone but can still cost gas; learn how to tell a revert from a pending transaction and what to check next.

item.title: BaiBai’s Three Integration Paths Put Routing Before Rebuilding
item.description: BaiBai’s route through KyberSwap is live, while direct access and liquidity provision pose different build costs, controls and unanswered questions.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow with 150ms finality target
item.description: Solana activated Anza’s Alpenglow consensus upgrade, replacing TowerBFT; its 150ms target could shorten final settlement, though live performance remains the test.

item.title: BaseSwap’s First Liquidity Deposit Has No Single Lock Minimum
item.description: BaseSwap has no single first-deposit lock amount: pool type and starting price set the deposit; any withdrawal lock is a separate choice.

item.title: Standard Chartered signs deal for 100% of Zodia Custody
item.description: Standard Chartered signed binding agreements for Zodia Custody, bringing regulated crypto custody in-house while its software business becomes a separate venture, pending approvals.

item.title: Anyswap routes depended on token and destination liquidity
item.description: Anyswap’s former router and bridge routes differed by token representation and destination liquidity; the service ceased operations, so route choice is no longer live.

item.title: Mantle Bridge or an Exchange? The Cost of an Occasional Transfer
item.description: For occasional transfers to Mantle, the canonical bridge preserves the asset and wallet control; an exchange may simplify cash-out but adds custody and conversion steps.
